decisions.detail: Six-item text navigation rail on desktop; Intel omitted from primary navigation.
Horizontal bounded navigation is retained because no authoritative mobile Figma frame was present.
State, primary value, reason, evidence strength, Coverage, actions, then technical disclosure.
Figma hierarchy is populated from governed crypto and supplemental Macro Projections; unavailable ETF flow remains classified.
Cards retain governed reference values and separately labeled live overlays.
Ranking remains investigation priority and does not adopt signal-like profit semantics.
Plain-language invalidation and combined counter-risk content replace repeated technical codes.
Facts, interpretation, support, opposition, strength, Coverage, and progressive technical disclosure follow the Figma hierarchy.
Bounded formatting and controls adopted; full timeline product redesign belongs to focused MVP-6B.
No request-time reconstruction or protected WebSocket change was introduced.
No Farside ETF value is displayed without a persisted Raw Artifact and governed observation.
Checksums, versions, raw IDs, and source digests moved into progressive disclosure where supported.
